newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia's Suharto urges private bank efficiency.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia's Suharto urges private bank efficiency.

text.p: Indonesia's President Suharto on Thursday urged national private banks to consolidate and to boost efficiency amid growing global competition.

"We feel sharper competition. We see that economic turmoil in one country can spread to become regional turmoil and it can even develop to become global turmoil," Suharto said, while opening a congress on Indonesian private banks.
"In this situation, it (efficency) is certainly the correct strategy. Banking circles face strong competition. For that, national banking circles must consolidate," Suharto said.
"There are many things to be done to boost efficiency," he added. "The quality of service, security of transactions...are important aspects in boosting efficiency," he said.
Suharto also said the difference in interest rates for deposits and loans was too high.
"It is far higher than internationally. As a result, business costs domestically are higher that they should be. We must make efforts to reduce that interest rate differential," he said.
